verdict.rationale: GitHub Projects documents native custom views: you can save configured table, board and roadmap views and share them with your team. Its insights let you create your own charts, which act as native dashboard-style widgets. However, these are configurations of built-in layouts. Nothing shows an integration or extension surface for building new view types or custom widgets, so only part of the story is covered. Missing for 10: an extension/UI SDK for building custom view types or widgets, design-system or embedding guidance for native look-and-feel, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a designer, I can build custom views and dashboard widgets that feel native to the product

citations.quote: You can save these views, allowing you to quickly return to them as needed and make them available to your team.
You can apply filters to the default chart and also create your own charts.
You can view your project as a high-density table layout, as a kanban board, or a timeline-style roadmap.
